title: Director, Field Reimbursement (Remote Strategic Leader)
description:
At Alcon , we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you will be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers.

We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon . As the Director, Field Reimbursement , you will provide strategic leadership for supporting patient access and reimbursement strategy across our U.S. Pharmaceutical Glaucoma and Dry Eye portfolio. Leading a geographically dispersed team of Field Access Managers, you will shape and execute scalable market access , patient access , and reimbursement strategies that help optimize access to therapy and drive business success. This is a remote U.S.-based role with approximately 50% domestic travel to support field engagement, customer interactions, cross-functional collaboration, and key business initiatives.

As a key member of the leadership team, you will partner closely with Commercial, Brand, Medical Affairs, Sales Leadership, and Commercial Operations to translate evolving payer policies , coverage dynamics , and reimbursement trends into actionable strategies that improve patient access and support organizational priorities. You will provide strategic oversight of reimbursement programs, guide cross-functional initiatives, and influence solutions across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and specialty pharmacy environments.

This opportunity is ideal for leaders with deep expertise in Field Reimbursement , Market Access , Patient Access , Payer Strategy , and Reimbursement Leadership who are passionate about driving meaningful change in healthcare. You will have the opportunity to shape national reimbursement and access strategies, lead a high-performing field organization, and collaborate across complex healthcare and pharmaceutical ecosystems to deliver measurable impact. If you have a proven track record of leading national teams, driving strategic initiatives, and influencing access outcomes, this role offers the chance to advance patient access while helping define the future of reimbursement strategy within a global healthcare leader.
A typical day, looks like:

Strategic Leadership & Program Oversight

• Provide strategic leadership and oversight for Field Reimbursement programs across the U.S. Pharmaceutical Glaucoma and Dry Eye portfolio, supporting consistent execution of program KPIs and service-level agreements.

• Develop and execute comprehensive national reimbursement and patient access strategies aligned with commercial objectives, with a focus on addressing potential reimbursement obstacles and improving access to medications.

• Participate as a key member of the Market Access senior leadership team and travel as needed for team development, client engagements, internal leadership meetings, training, and market access initiatives.

People Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, coach, and develop six geographically dispersed Field Access Managers, partnering with training teams and vendors to strengthen field reimbursement capabilities and support organizational goals.

• Monitor territory effectiveness to optimize field productivity and recommend territory realignment opportunities to support business objectives and customer needs.

Market Access Strategy & Reimbursement Excellence

• Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures for reimbursement support services, including benefits verification, prior authorizations, and appeals.

• Serve as a subject matter expert on payer requirements and reimbursement processes, translating complex coverage dynamics into clear, actionable guidance for internal stakeholders and field teams.

Students: Across the USA, grades K to 8 (choose your grade levels to tutor)

•

title: Senior Kubernetes Administrator

• Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

• Certification in Kubernetes administration (e.g., Certified Kubernetes Administrator - CKA).

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in IT operations, with at least 5 years focused on Kubernetes administration.

• In-depth knowledge of Kubernetes architecture, components, and ecosystem.

• Proficiency in container technologies such as Docker, container networking, and storage.

• Strong scripting skills (e.g., Bash, Python) and experience with automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform).

• Solid understanding of Linux operating systems and system administration.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in distributed systems.

title: Director, Clinical Development
description:
About Us
Join us in helping patients with rare diseases. At Egetis Therapeutics we challenge the status quo for the benefit of those in need. We offer an open, positive and supportive culture where everyone can be their best. Through trust, we work seamlessly across functions. As an employee you are empowered and encouraged to have an entrepreneurial spirit, enjoying an organization with conscious and efficient decision-making and we take pride in our collaborative working environment! In February 2025, the European Commission approved Egetis’ Emcitate® (tiratricol) as the first and only treatment of peripheral thyrotoxicosis in patients with monocarboxylate transporter 8 (MCT8) deficiency (Allan-Herndon-Dudley syndrome). In March 2026, the U.S. FDA accepted the filing of Egetis’ New Drug Application (NDA) for Emcitate® (tiratricol) for the treatment of MCT8 deficiency and granted Priority Review. The Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date is September 28, 2026.
As a courageous, committed, and collaborative organization, we are seeking to grow our team to drive success both in the pre-launch and post launch phases. For more information, please visit our website at www.egetis.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

Our Values
Courageous - Challenge the status quo for the benefit of the patient
Committed - Operate with high ethical standards through an efficient organization to deliver top quality results
Collaborative - Through trust, work seamlessly across functions and with external partners

Purpose of the role
The Director, Clinical Development provides the medical and scientific leadership required to oversee the design, conduct, and interpretation of assigned clinical study(ies) within the tiratricol programs and other Egetis development projects. Acting as the study physician, the role holder serves as the primary medical point of accountability for study-level clinical strategy, participant safety, data integrity, and scientific quality, working cross-functionally with Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, and external investigators and vendors, under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Egetis headquarters is in Stockholm, Sweden, and we welcome applications from candidates based anywhere within the Central European timezone (CET/CEST) with no relocation required. Stockholm-based or near-by area applicants are equally welcome to work from our office. Duties and Responsibilities
Clinical strategy and study design

• Provide medical and scientific input into the study concept, target product profile, and clinical development plan for the assigned indication.

• Author or co-author the clinical sections of the study protocol, including objectives, endpoints, eligibility criteria, dosing rationale, and estimands; ensure scientific and ethical integrity of the design.

• Contribute to protocol synopses, amendments, and the design of the schedule of activities, ensuring feasibility and alignment with regulatory expectations.

• Provide clinical input into case report form (CRF) design, edit checks, and the data management and monitoring plans.

Medical oversight of study conduct

• Act as the study physician / medical monitor, providing day-to-day medical guidance to sites, Clinical Operations, and the CRO throughout study conduct.

• Review eligibility questions, protocol deviations, and dose-modification decisions; respond to investigator medical queries in a timely manner.

• Provide medical input into monitoring strategy, site selection, investigator engagement, and study start-up activities.

• Support recruitment and retention through medical education of sites and development of study-specific medical guidance and FAQs.

Participant safety and pharmacovigilance

• Serve as the medical reviewer for adverse events and serious adverse events at the study level; perform ongoing medical review of safety data in collaboration with Pharmacovigilance.

Develop bills of material, cost estimates, and procurement support documentation.

Proficiency with AutoCAD and Microsoft Excel.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maritime Manufacturing Technology team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies and processes for cutting-edge defense hardware, including deployable static and moving surface, undersea and sea to air vehicles and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

As an Electrical Assembly Technician, you'll wear two hats. On the product side, you'll assemble panels and switchboards, pull and route cable, terminate connectors, hook up motors, and outfit marine compartments with complete electrical systems. On the facility side, you'll size transformers, run high-voltage feeds to CNC machines and production equipment, install distribution panels, and keep the shop floor powered and operational. You'll be expected to own the work from sizing through installation and energization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Assemble electrical panels, switchboards, junction boxes, and controller enclosures. Install components, wire per schematics, and dress/lace wiring.

• Pull, route, and secure cable through compartment foundations, hangers, stuffing tubes, and penetrations.

• Terminate cables at connectors, terminal blocks, lugs, and equipment interfaces.

• Hook up motors, controllers, and actuators: verify phasing, megging, and continuity.

• Support electrical testing.

• Groom completed electrical systems for company, customer, and government inspections.

• Install, wire, and terminate high-voltage equipment feeds for CNC machines, welding equipment, overhead cranes, and production tooling.

• Size and install transformers (480V to 240V step-down) for production equipment requirements.

• Install conduit, cable tray, wireways, and raceways per NEC.

• Wire distribution panels, disconnects, motor starters, and VFDs.

• Perform facility electrical troubleshooting and repair - identify faults, replace components, restore service.

• Coordinate with equipment vendors on power requirements, connection diagrams, and commissioning.

• Ensure all facility electrical work meets NEC, OSHA, and local code requirements.

• Complete hardcopy and electronic documentation: assembly travelers, test records, cable logs, termination sheets.

• Maintain compliance with NAVSEA, SUBSAFE, and SOC requirements as applicable to submarine electrical systems.

• Red-line drawings and report discrepancies through proper channels.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or GED.

• 7+ years of electrical experience: industrial, shipboard, or manufacturing environments.

• Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, and cable schedules.

• Experience with 480V 3-phase and 208/240V single- and 3-phase systems - installation, termination, and troubleshooting.

• Experience pulling, routing, and terminating electrical cable.

• Proficiency with wire harness fabrication: crimping, soldering, connector assembly.

• Working knowledge of NEC for facility electrical installations.

• Experience using meggers, multimeters, hi-pot testers, and phase rotation meters.

• Willing to work any shift and overtime as production requires.

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities.

description:
Are you an active-duty service member or a family member interested in the DoD Skillbridge Program? At Degy, we are proud to offer a comprehensive program designed to support our military members during their transition to civilian careers. We participate in the Skillbridge initiative, providing valuable opportunities for service members to gain hands-on experience.
Our Skillbridge program supports 90 days up to the full 180 day program. Program participation is unique to each applicant, so please let us know your tentative start and end date when you apply and we will work with you! It is a fully-remote internship program and anyone is eligible to apply for one of the following teams: Booking & Sales, Marketing, Special Projects, Major Event Operation, and Roster Operations.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Microsoft 365, Jira, and workflow automation tools, and is eager to apply AI-driven strategies to improve team efficiency.
FOR MORE INFORMATION ON THE DOD SKILLBRIDGE PROGRAM PLEASE VISIT:

Requirements
DoDI 1322.29 lists general eligibility requirements as -

• Service members may participate within 180 days of being discharged or released from active duty and service members must have served 180 continuous days on active duty.

• Approval authority rests with the first field grade commander authorized to impose non-judicial punishment under Article 15 of the UCMJ in the service member's chain of command.

• Such commanders may approve or disapprove participation by a service member based upon unit mission requirements.

How do service members apply to become participants in a SkillBridge program?
Interested service members can ask questions about participation by contacting their installation SkillBridge point of contact; the SkillBridge POC may be in the transition assistance office, education office, or other installation support office. Additional information about how to start the process and your services specific guidance for applying to SkillBridge may be found in How to Participate.
Who authorizes a Service member's participation in a SkillBridge Program?
The interested service member must gain approval from his or her unit commander. Specifically, the service member must seek approval from the first commander in his or her chain of command in the pay grade of O-4 or above.

title: Account Executive (m/w/d) im Außendienst (new markets) - Braunschweig
description:
Salonkee kommt nach Braunschweig und sucht die erste Person im Vertrieb. Du fühlst dich im Sales zu Hause und hast Lust, ein eigenes Gebiet im Außendienst aufzubauen? Bei uns heißt das: Verantwortung übernehmen, kurze Sales-Zyklen betreuen, ungedeckelte Provision verdienen und echte Entwicklungschancen nutzen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

- Du gibst dein Wissen weiter - im Roleplay, im Shadowing und im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen, die neu dabei sind.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung über den gesamten Sales-Cycle hinweg, von der Kaltakquise bis zum Closing.

- Hohe Selbststeuerung und Eigenverantwortung - du gehörst zu den ersten Teammitgliedern vor Ort.

- Du bist es gewohnt, an KPIs gemessen zu werden und hast deine eigenen Zahlen stets im Blick.

- Du schaffst es, ein komplexes Produkt verständlich zu vermitteln und dabei zu begeistern.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Klare Entwicklungschancen: Nächste Senioritätsstufen erreichst du mit deiner Performance - simpel gehalten und schnell erreichbar. Außerdem besetzen wir Team-Lead-Rollen bevorzugt aus dem eigenen Team und begleiten den Weg dorthin mit unserer Sales Manager Academy.

- Eine Führungskraft und Kolleg:innen, die dich jederzeit unterstützen.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Spain | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

 

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.

About Product Management

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The role

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will: 

• Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value

Sleutel jij graag aan techniek die blijft bewegen? Als Liftmonteur in onze werkplaats zorg jij ervoor dat bouwliften in topconditie blijven. Met jouw technische kennis los je storingen op en maak je iedere lift klaar voor gebruik.

Jouw baan als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats bij RECO
Als Liftmonteur op de werkplaats van de afdeling Verticaal Transport bij RECO zorg jij dat onze bouwliften altijd veilig draaien en klaarstaan voor de volgende klus. Jij sleutelt aan personen- en goederenliften, loopt ze volledig na en zorgt dat storingen snel opgelost worden. Of het nou mechanisch of elektrisch is: jij zoekt het probleem op en vindt de passende oplossing. Ook bij grotere of ingewikkelde storingen draai jij je hand niet om voor een goede oplossing.
Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit:
✅ Onderhouden, inspecteren en gereedmaken van bouwliften in onze werkplaats. ✅ Opsporen en verhelpen van mechanische en elektrische storingen.
✅ Zelfstandig complexe storingen uitlezen, analyseren en verhelpen; ✅ Werken vanuit de werkplaats en waar nodig afstemmen met collega-monteurs om samen tot de beste oplossing te komen.
Requirements

Wat breng jij mee?
👍 Je bent 32 - 40 uur per week beschikbaar van 7-16 uur;👍 Werkervaring hebt op het gebied van mechatronisch en bij voorkeur ook elektrotechniek; 👍 Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal; 👍 Je hebt bij voorkeur een rijbewijs B en eigen vervoer in bezit; 👍 Je bent in het bezit van je VCA-certificaat óf wil deze via ons behalen; 👍 Je bent een echte doener, neemt initiatief, probleemoplossend vermogen én kunt goed samenwerken.

✅ Een goed salaris;

✅ Overwer

title: Senior MLOps Engineer, Buyer
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems-like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations-that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match: 

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll 

• Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.

• Build continuous training (CT) pipelines: design, build, and maintain automated workflows for data preparation, model training, and batch scoring.

• Automate model serving & integration: package and deploy traditional ML models (e.g., in ONNX format) to our existing serving infrastructure, primarily Vespa and/or Triton.

• Close the deployment loop: automate model deployments where they are still manual. For example, building a GitHub Action that deploys a new model to Vespa, triggered by a webhook from a successful Vertex AI training pipeline.

• Build the missing quality gates: build the automated quality and evaluation gates that our pipelines lack today. This includes:

• Establish and uphold ML Model Lifecycle Standards: Take ownership of and continuously improve the standards, quality, and governance of the complete ML model lifecycle

About you 

• We are looking for an "ML-literate" Software Engineer, not a Data Scientist. You are a builder and an automator with a strong service mindset.

• Must-have technical skills: deep expertise in GCP/Vertex AI (or equivalents like SageMaker), Kubernetes, and Docker.

• Automation expertise: proven experience building robust CI/CD and automation pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.).

• ML-Literate: you understand ML workflows and concepts (training, evaluation, inference) well enough to debug pipelines and build meaningful quality gates.

• Soft skills: a strong "service mindset," excellent communic

title: Associate Specialist, People Operations

Light & Wonder’s corporate team is comprised of incredible talent that works across the enterprise, defying boundaries to provide essential services in an extraordinary manner to ensure the success of the organization and the well-being of employees.
Position Summary
Looking to grow your HR career in a role that’s dynamic, people-focused, and full of variety? As an Associate Specialist in our HR Shared Service Team (known internally as the People Solution Center or PSC), you’ll be the go-to partner for our Creators across the U.S. No two days are the same; you’ll be solving problems, answering questions, and helping shape a smooth employee experience from start to finish. If you’re energized by fast-paced work, love connecting with people, and want to make an impact across the Americas, this role is for you!

The People Solution Center Americas supports ~3,000 employees across six countries, providing world-class HR services with a focus on accuracy, responsiveness, and care. We manage HR processes, policies, and employee data in Workday, while serving as trusted partners to employees and managers alike. This role reports to the Manager, PSC - Americas.

What You’ll Do:

• Be the first point of contact for HR questions, from policies to processes.

• Provide accurate, helpful support with empathy and a people-first mindset.

• Investigate and resolve employee concerns, escalating when needed and always following up.

• Keep employee records clean and up to date in Workday; pull reports when needed.

• Spot opportunities to improve how we work - and share your ideas.

• Deliver high-quality HR transactions and support in line with service levels.

• Support hiring and onboarding after the offer stage - contracts, background checks, and getting new hires ready for Day One.

• Conduct compliance checks (think: right-to-work, policy audits, and documentation).

• Jump in on projects that make our People Solution Center even better.

What You Bring:

• Real-world HR experience (bonus points if you’ve supported employees directly).

• Comfortable navigating employee questions and solving day-to-day HR challenges.

• Experience with HRIS systems, Workday is a big plus.

• Able to manage multiple tasks and shift gears quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications

• Education: A bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or a related field is great, but equivalent experience works too!

• Experience: 1-2 years in HR or a people-focused role (customer service counts, if you’ve solved problems and supported people, we want to hear from you).

• Systems: Comfortable with HRIS systems; bonus points if you’ve clicked around Workday before.

• Skills: Strong communicator, organized multitasker, and natural problem-solver who can roll with change in a fast-paced environment.

• Mindset: Trusted with sensitive information, and you handle it with integrity and care.

Your Superpowers:

• Empathy & Communication: You listen well, respond thoughtfully, and know how to connect with people.

• Collaboration: You love being part of a team and working cross-functionally.

• Cultural Awareness: You value inclusion and different perspectives, and it shows.

• Problem-Solving: You think critically, stay calm under pressure, and find smart solutions.

• Proactive Energy: You don’t wait for answers, you dig in, take initiative, and make things happen.

• Integrity: You handle sensitive info with care, discretion, and professionalism.

Why Join Us?
You’ll be part of a global People team that’s always evolving. We’re building better HR; not just for today, but for the future. Expect variety, impact, and a team that genuinely supports each other.

• Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance

• 3 weeks’ Vacation and Holidays (about 11 a year)

• HSA or FSA account and other voluntary benefits

• 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with Employer Match Program

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Product Engineer (Client Platform)

(€85K - €115K • Offers Equity)

We're looking for a Product Engineer to develop our Client Platform: A system to handle and allow our Clients to operate all of their work easily with us.

The goal is to build a minimal, usable platform that lets clients do every important action themselves. It automates what can be automated and makes the rest easy to see and act on.

Our Client Platform sits at the core of our business, so what you build will directly shape how our clients work with us every day.

Tech Stack 💻

- Python + FastAPI

- TypeScript + NestJS, NextJS

- dbt, BigQuery, Hex, PostgreSQL, MongoDB

- Google Cloud Platform

What You’ll Do 🎯

- Develop self-serve application features for our Business Clients & Internal Growth Management Team,

- Own the data, backend & frontend implementation for your domains, interface clearly with Data, Engineering & Growth Teams,

- Leverage LLMs, and chat agents while maintaining your own understanding of what you built at the correct layer of abstraction & actively contribute to our AI Engineering environment.

What You’ll Bring 🚀

- A university degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 3+ years working with our tech stack or similar tools

- A passion for building features end to end, from backend logic to the user interface

- Comfort with AI-assisted development and agent-based coding tools in your daily workflow

- A habit of keeping systems strictly typed, documented and organized

- Enjoying communication and the ability to organize projects across teams

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

- You’re driven by results you can actually see: what you build becomes part of how our clients work everyday with us

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
Job Ad (2026 05)
We're looking for a Cloud Operations Engineer to run our production deployments and act as the operational point of contact for our US-based client team.
The role has two modes. During release cycles, you focus on planning and executing deployments alongside the client. Between releases, you focus on improving the infrastructure and tooling that supports them: CI/CD pipelines, runbooks, observability, automation.
The right person for this role is comfortable in Kubernetes and Helm, knows their way around a Linux shell, and is fine flexing into US working hours when there's a deployment in flight. You're someone who likes things to work, communicates clearly when they don't, and stays calm when production is on the line.
WHAT YOU'RE GOING TO DO
During deployment cycles:
● Plan, schedule, and execute production deployments in coordination with the client's engineering team
● Flex into US working hours (afternoon/evening Romania time) during deployment windows to align with the client on releases, change requests, and incident response
● Act as the day-to-day operational point of contact between our team and the client during release cycles
● Investigate and resolve deployment, networking, and infrastructure issues in production, escalating to the engineering team when needed
● Communicate deployment status, risks, and incidents clearly to both client and internal teams
Between deployment cycles:
● Improve the deployment infrastructure and tooling: CI/CD pipelines, Helm charts, runbooks, observability, automation
● Work on broader cloud and Kubernetes operations: cluster maintenance, networking, secret management, cost and reliability improvements
● Help shape deployment processes and change management as the platform grows
Requirements
QUALITIES
● You take pride in clean, predictable deployments and good change discipline
● You enjoy working directly with a client team: writing tickets, joining their stand-ups when needed, being the single point of contact during deployment windows
● You're fine with a schedule that flexes (some weeks heavy US overlap, some weeks normal EU hours) instead of a fixed 9-to-5
● You stay composed during incidents and communicate clearly under pressure
● You ask questions when something looks wrong instead of pushing through
● You document what you do, so the next person (or you, three months from now) doesn't
have to reverse-engineer it
● Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, etc.) as part of your daily workflow
QUALIFICATIONS
● 3+ years of experience in operations, DevOps, SRE, or related hands-on infrastructure roles
● Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
● Solid Kubernetes experience: deployments, services, ingress, debugging pods and workloads.
● Helm charts: reading, editing, templating, and deploying them.
● Networking knowledge across cloud and Kubernetes: Load Balancers, Ingress controllers, NGINX, Istio, Cilium, Azure CNI.
● CI/CD experience with ArgoCD and GitLab CI
● Scripting and coding in bash, Python, or Go
● Solid Linux fundamentals: filesystem, CLI, log and process troubleshooting
● Strong written and spoken English (mandatory: you'll be in daily contact with the client)
NICE TO HAVE
● Prior experience working directly with US-based clients or distributed teams
● On-call or production support experience in an enterprise / regulated environment
● Familiarity with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry)
● Exposure to Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
● Experience with secret management tools (Vault, CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)
● Completed technical university degree
WHAT WE OFFER
● A monthly amount dedicated to well-being needs
● A monthly subscription to medical services
● 21 vacation days / year; extra vacation days after 2 years within the company
● 3 personal days / year
● Referral bonus
● Access to learning platforms for continuous self-devel

title: Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth
description:
About the Team

Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.

About the Role

In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.

A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.

In This Role, You Will:

- Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth.

- Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API.

- Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage.

- Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider.

- Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You:

- Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest.

- Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.

Qualifications

- Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision.

- Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads.

- Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business.

- Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
ABOUT US

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring our founding Business Development Representatives. Today, pipeline at Lorikeet comes from founders, AEs, and a growing demand gen engine. This role exists to add a focused, outbound-first motion on top of that, and you’ll take on far more than a typical BDR seat: building the team, the process, the structure, and the program for the BDRs who come after you. It’s a high-visibility role with real room to grow, into an Account Executive seat, our deployment team, or other roles across the company.

The people you’ll be reaching out to run support for regulated, high-stakes businesses: a telehealth company where a wrong answer is a compliance problem, a fintech where a support ticket can mean someone’s money is stuck. They’ve usually been burned by a chatbot before. Your job isn’t to blast them with sequences, it’s to understand their support operation well enough to show them, specifically, why this time is different, and to earn the first conversation.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with our AEs, founders, and GTM Engineer, and you’ll have a direct line to product. We’re AI-native as a company, and that goes double for how we prospect: you’ll be expected to build and use your own AI tooling, not just run someone else’s cadence.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Generate qualified pipeline for our AE team across mid-market and enterprise accounts in fintech, healthtech, marketplaces, and delivery

- Research target accounts deeply, from ticket volumes, channels, regulatory constraints, how their current support experience actually works - and turn that into a sharp, personal reason to talk

- Run multi-threaded outbound across email, phone, and LinkedIn to Heads of Support, CX, and Operations, and the executives above them

- Test-drive prospects’ existing support experiences and bring what you find into your outreach (it’s one of the most effective openers we have)

- Follow up fast on inbound, events, and campaigns, partnering with Demand Gen so nothing warm goes cold

- Build and iterate on your own AI-powered prospecting workflows with Claude Code and our GTM Engineer - research agents, account scoring, personalised messaging at scale

- Qualify rigorously and hand off cleanly, so AEs walk into first calls already knowing the account

- Feed what you hear from the market back to sales, marketing, and product - objections, competitor mentions, and the problems buyers actually care about

- Own your territory and account plans: decide where to focus, build engagement plans for key accounts, and prepare thoroughly before every outreach

- Build the BDR function from the ground up: the playbook, what we measure, which plays work, and how we hire and onboard the next BDRs

THE RIGHT CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- 1-3 years of experience in a BDR/SDR or other customer-facing, target-carrying role

title: BIM Manager (COD179)
description:
Position Summary
The BIM Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes across projects and teams. This role ensures consistency, accuracy, and collaboration within BIM environments, supporting project delivery through effective model coordination, standards enforcement, and stakeholder alignment from design through construction and closeout.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of BIM standards, workflows, templates, and best practices.

• Manage and coordinate BIM models across multiple disciplines, ensuring model integrity, accuracy, and compliance with project requirements.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for BIM-related matters across projects, teams, and external partners.

• Support project teams with BIM planning, execution strategies, and model coordination throughout the project lifecycle.

• Oversee clash detection, coordination meetings, and issue resolution processes.

• Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Engineers, Designers, and Construction Teams to align BIM deliverables with project goals.

• Monitor model quality, data consistency, and adherence to BIM execution plans (BEPs).

• Provide training, guidance, and mentoring to BIM Coordinators, Modelers, and Designers.

• Support client requirements related to BIM deliverables, data standards, and asset information.

• Assist with 4D/5D modeling, model-based quantity take-offs, and construction sequencing when required.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to BIM tools, processes, and digital transformation.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Proven experience as a BIM Manager, BIM Lead, or Senior BIM Coordinator on complex projects.

• Strong understanding of BIM methodologies, coordination processes, and model-based workflows.

• Advanced proficiency in BIM and design software such as Revit, Navisworks, AutoCAD, and related collaboration platforms.

• Experience managing BIM execution plans (BEPs) and multidisciplinary models.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with large-scale or complex facilities (commercial, healthcare, industrial, data centers, or infrastructure).

• Familiarity with ISO 19650 or similar international BIM standards.

• Experience supporting construction-phase BIM, field coordination, and model-based delivery.

• Knowledge of data management, asset handover, and digital twin concepts.

• Demonstrated leadership experience within BIM or digital delivery teams.
